summary.headline: Godawari Power Q2 FY27 revenue rose 25% YoY to ₹1,632 crore, but margins fell sharply on costlier purchased iron ore and coal; mining guidance cut to 2.5 Mt.
summary.overview: Consolidated revenue grew 25% YoY to ₹1,632 crore in Q2 FY27 and 29% to ₹3,382 crore in H1, driven by volume and realisation. Profitability compressed because the company bought iron ore from the market at about ₹3,300-3,500/t while captive mining was constrained by overburden dumping space, and coal costs rose. Management cut FY27 iron ore mining guidance from 3.4 Mt to 2.5 Mt and pellet guidance from 4.4 Mt to 3.5 Mt, and expects margin recovery from Q4 FY27 once dumping land approval is received. The 20 GWh battery storage project is on track for commissioning around June-July 2027, and a new 3 GWh-scale BESS line was added.

segments.name: Iron ore mining and pellets
segments.commentary: Mining hit by overburden dumping space constraint; FY27 mining guidance cut to 2.5 Mt (from 3.4 Mt) and pellet guidance to 3.5 Mt (from 4.4 Mt). A 2 Mt pellet plant was temporarily shut as uneconomical; merchant high-grade pellet sales have been nil for months, and pellet prices are about ₹10,500/t.

segments.name: Sponge iron, billets, steel (captive chain)
segments.commentary: Sponge iron capacity raised from 5.25 to 5.75 Mt, with near-100% captive use in billet making; management says non-pellet chain is performing, though DRI costs rose about ₹1,000/t.

segments.name: Ferro alloys / power
segments.commentary: Captive power capacity expanding from 190 MW to 290 MW; 25 MW solar commissioned in late FY26, 100 MW solar delayed to December 2026. Lower captive power generation affected ferro alloys output in Q2.

segments.name: Cold rolled steel (CRM)
segments.commentary: Project relocated from Chhattisgarh to Maharashtra (Marasa, 71.45 acres allotted). Commissioning now expected around December 2027, possibly stretching to March 2028; ₹100 crore container line approved, commissioning by March 2027.

segments.name: Battery energy storage (BESS)
segments.commentary: 20 GWh project targeting Q1 FY28 commissioning, with ₹2,795 crore sanction (₹700 crore term loan, ₹100 crore working capital, ~₹2,000 crore non-fund). A new 3 GWh line (₹35 crore) targets December 2027 commissioning; a subsidiary Davi Energy Solution was formed for tenders.

guidance_outlook: FY27 iron ore mining guidance cut to 2.5 Mt from 3.4 Mt; pellet production guidance cut to 3.5 Mt from 4.4 Mt.
Margins expected to recover from Q4 FY27 on dumping land approval and beneficiation plant commissioning (Q3 FY27 target); normalised margins from Q1 FY28.
Mining expected to reach about 70-80% of capacity from Q1 FY28 and 85% in FY28; about 6 Mt annual run-rate from October 2027 per management.
Management expects iron ore purchases from market of about 2 Mt in FY27, with about 0.5 Mt in FY28 and none from FY29.
Iron ore pellet prices expected around $90/t in the near term per management; domestic pellet price ₹10,000/t assumed for a sustainable band.
Vision target of 4x revenue and 3x EBITDA growth, per management.
capex_capacity: Dumping ground approval expected within days; roughly 3-4 weeks to clear land after approval, with mining ramp from Q4 FY27.
Beneficiation plant commissioning targeted Q3 FY27; full-scale operations by FY28.
20 GWh BESS: first container dispatched from China; first container targeted end-Q1 FY28 (June 2027), full commissioning around June-July 2027 per management.
CRM complex (Marasa, Maharashtra): ₹500 crore capex mentioned; commissioning now Dec 2027, possibly March 2028.
Solar: 100 MW solar delayed to Dec 2026; 45 MW BESS for solar also targeted Dec 2026. 15 MW solar via 26% stake in Solar Craft Power India 32 (₹26 crore investment).
₹100 crore EV capex for 50 vehicles at mines and plants.
demand_pricing: International pellet/DRI benchmark around $199/t in early November amid weak Chinese demand and rising global supply; expected near-term average around $90/t.
Domestic steel demand: finished steel consumption up 7.6% YoY in H1 FY27; crude steel production up 2.9% YoY.
Domestic pellet prices moved from ₹8,500/t to ₹11,000/t then back to ₹10,500/t; high-grade premium of ~₹1,000/t lost as merchant sales halted.
Pellet price on a sustainable basis estimated at ₹10,000/t; at full mining, margin per tonne of about ₹4,000 per management.
Competition: management says ~40-50% BESS demand in India is government tenders; capacity announcements are rising sharply but largely on paper.

qa_highlights.question: How is the company managing mine approval delays and the debt-funded capex, given margin pressure?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said the forest-land (dumping) permission could come any day; ₹500 crore of CRM capex is covered and about ₹900 crore free cash is available, with long-term loans also taken. No cash constraint is foreseen.

qa_highlights.question: How much of the margin drop comes from purchased iron ore versus price movement?
qa_highlights.answer: Purchased iron ore at ~₹3,300-3,500/t, lost ~₹1,000/t premium on high-grade pellets and lower volumes; DRI cost up ~₹1,500/t and power cost up ₹25-30 crore per quarter. Finished product prices also rose (billet ₹36-38k to ₹43k; DRI ₹34k to ₹29k), so management does not call it a pure beta loss.

qa_highlights.question: What is the outlook for Q3 and FY28 margins?
qa_highlights.answer: Q3 margins similar to Q2; Q4 improvement; normalised margins from Q1 FY28.

qa_highlights.question: What is the BESS plan and expected utilisation?
qa_highlights.answer: A new subsidiary Davi Energy Solution was formed for tenders; 10-20% utilisation expected in year one for the 5 MWh container line, rising to 20-25% by March 2028.

qa_highlights.question: What are the BESS project economics?
qa_highlights.answer: For the ₹1,400 crore BESS project at 80% utilisation, revenue about ₹1,300 crore and EBITDA about ₹600 crore per annum; payback about 3-3.5 years. Cell technology 6.28 MWh expected to save 4-5% operating cost.

qa_highlights.question: What is the reserve life at the Ad-Dongri and Pauri-Tipu mines?
qa_highlights.answer: Ad-Dongri reserve about 80 Mt, supporting full capacity for ~15 years; Pauri-Tipu about 75 Mt of low-grade ore, with only 25-30 Mt usable at 30-40% recovery; 4 Mt beneficiation planned.

qa_highlights.question: Steel plant and inter-corporate loans?
qa_highlights.answer: Steel plant remains on hold pending water approvals. About ₹120 crore inter-corporate loans at 15-20% interest, to be recalled over 9-12 months.

risks_watch: Dumping ground and forest approvals still pending; Q4 mining ramp depends on them.
Margins depend on market iron ore purchases until mining ramps; Q3 margins guided flat.
Large debt-funded capex (~₹2,795 crore BESS financing, ~₹2,000 crore non-fund) and possible Chinese-supplier execution risk.
Global pellet/DRI price pressure and new low-cost supply, including the Srimandu project.
BESS overcapacity risk as capacity announcements in India rise rapidly.
CRM delayed to Dec 2027/Mar 2028 and steel plant on hold.
summary.management_tone: Confident on approvals and the mining ramp timeline, though guidance was cut and several timelines (CRM, solar) slipped. Answers on margins were defensive, attributing the decline to input costs and asserting that finished product prices also rose.
